# Third-party code

`skhd/src/` contains unmodified source files from skhd v0.3.9 by Åsmund Vikane:
https://github.com/asmvik/skhd/tree/v0.3.9

License: MIT; see `skhd/LICENSE.txt`.

Archive: https://github.com/asmvik/skhd/archive/refs/tags/v0.3.9.tar.gz
SHA-256: 9ca31556288d4cdfbd57974a10a9486b9d2b7d44eba16be62878fd25dd8ab8d2

The build compiles this source locally. Yabai is not vendored: the application
can download the official release when the user chooses to install it.
